facts.text: The clone is DAQ software for a Tektronix TDS 3052 oscilloscope over an RS-232 connection
The clone opens the scope into the module-level VISA resource tds
The script asks the instrument for its identity with *IDN? and reads the reply
A setting is sent as a command word, a space and its value, for example 'CH1:SCA ' + value
The channel vertical scales are read back with CH1:SCALE? and CH2:SCALE?
The record length is restricted to the tokens 5.E2 and 1.E4
The coupling choices are AC and DC, and the input impedance choices are FIF and MEG
The trigger source is written as EXT or CH<n>
The trigger slope choices are RISE and FALL
The clone locks the front panel with LOC All and sets the acquisition stop condition to SEQ
The clone releases the front-panel lock with LOC NONE when it finishes
The module's only top-level definitions are the plotting callbacks init, finished, writeEvent and animate

operator_required.name: ch1_scale
operator_required.reason: The clone passes --vsca1 through to CH1:SCA but states no vertical-scale range; the operator supplies the bound of this scope.

operator_required.name: ch2_scale
operator_required.reason: The clone passes --vsca2 through to CH2:SCA but states no vertical-scale range; the operator supplies the bound of this scope.

operator_required.name: horizontal_scale
operator_required.reason: The clone passes --hsamp through to HOR:SCA but states no time-per-division range; the operator supplies the bound of this scope.

operator_required.name: trigger_level
operator_required.reason: The clone passes --trlevel through to TRIGGER:A:LEVEL but states no level range; the operator supplies the bound of this scope.

operator_required.name: trigger_position
operator_required.reason: The clone passes --pretrigger through to HOR:TRIG:POS but states no percentage range; the operator supplies the bound of this scope.

safe_state.description: acquisition set to stop after the current sequence and the front-panel remote lock released
